system.description:
• Effect: On one hit of your choice against your marked prey each round, choose one: Hamstring (its speed is halved until the end of its next turn), Pin (until the end of its next turn, it can't move away from you without a Reflex save against your Class Save DC) or Expose (the next ally to attack it has Advantage).
  • From 8th level, your Quarry Strike's hit can carry a trick too.
  • This combines with the Favoured Enemy die.

activities.name: Hamstring
activities.text: On a hit against your marked prey: its speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

activities.name: Pin
activities.text: On a hit against your marked prey: until the end of its next turn, it can't move away from you without a Reflex save against your Class Save DC.

activities.name: Expose
activities.text: On a hit against your marked prey: the next ally to attack it has Advantage.
